experiment_template.research_question: Can the adapted ARE agent produce a scored real-task patch, and does source-preserving projection remain intact?
stop_conditions: At most 24 model and 48 tokenizer calls, no retries or replacements.
Stop on source drift, missing cleanup or provider failure.

success_criteria.generalization: Always inconclusive from a single development task.
success_criteria.integration: Attributable proposal and complete trustworthy task score; a failed patch is a valid outcome.
success_criteria.mechanism: Exact source payload retained by every projection.

records.falsifier: Any source-content mismatch or untraceable projection.
records.mechanism: Remove redundant envelope digest and byte-count fields while retaining output and source provenance.
records.scope: One Svelte development task, adapted common executor, 12K local threshold.
records.statement: H23 can be exercised on a real external repository task while preserving source payloads.
